posts.title: It's not always the dishes
posts.description: On average I make about 18 meals a week at home. The preparation of each meal involves using one knife, one intermediate dump-all-the-things-to-throw-in-the-bin-here bowl, one pan, one disposable paper plate 1 , one ceramic plate, and a few pieces of cutlery.
